subject: Goal triage and dependency escalation for Q3 midpoint
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Goal triage and dependency escalation for Q3 midpoint

Team —

This is the mid-point check-in for our top-level Q3 OKRs. Quick summary and asks below. I listed owners next to each line; please update the Drive scoreboard (link below) with any delta by end of week.

Objective A — Reduce inference cost per token by 30% (owner: Marcus)
- Current status: running experiments on batching + quant profiles; estimated impact ~18% to date.
- Blocker: Dedicated pool allocation for a 3-day controlled run; we need +4 T4s for a week to validate.
- Ask: Marcus, can you confirm availability and ETA for capacity? If not possible, please propose an alternative timeline.

Objective B — Improve multi-region latency SLO to 99th pct <= 220ms (owner: Grace)
- Current status: tracking at 260ms 99p in NA, EU a little better.
- Proposal: temporary scope reduction: limit cross-region routing to critical routes for the next 6 weeks to meet SLO in NA.
- Ask: Grace, please provide impact on customers and suggested routes to exclude.

Objective C — Expand paid pilot coverage (owner: Laura)
- Current status: two inbound pilots (ACME, Nimbus). ACME requests a QBR and a tighter mutual action plan.
- Ask: Laura, please confirm proposed agenda and who will join from product + infra for the QBR. Sara from ACME is on the thread for scheduling.

Attachments: QBR_metrics_v2.xlsx (scoreboard snapshot). Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cQBR

High-level ask: by Fri 23 Jul EOD — Marcus: capacity yes/no + ETA; Grace: scope-reduction specifics; Laura: confirm ACME QBR attendees and preferred dates the week of 7/27. I will consolidate and publish the re-scoped KR statements and updated timeline.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goal triage and dependency escalation for Q3 midpoint

On Tue, Jul 20, 2026 at 9:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> This is the mid-point check-in for our top-level Q3 OKRs...

Thanks Jonas — quick updates from my side.

Objective C (pilots)
- ACME: Sara is asking for a QBR the week of 7/27; they want a 45-minute review plus 30 minutes for roadmap/discussion. I'll own the customer-facing portion.
- Nimbus: still in discovery; lower probability, so I'm recommending we avoid committing infra to them until ACME QBR is done.

Proposed ACME QBR attendees from Redwood: Laura (CS, lead), Grace (Product, roadmap), Marcus (Infra, performance), Jonas (optional exec intro).

On scope: I support a temporary scope reduction on non-critical cross-region routes for Objective B as long as we keep customers with strict latency on a fall-through path to the dedicated pool.

Deliverable: I'll draft the Mutual Action Plan and share as a Google doc by 7/22.

Attachments: none in this note.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goal triage and dependency escalation for Q3 midpoint

Jonas / team —

Short answer on capacity: we can provide the +4 T4s, but not on the 7/23 window. Earliest availability is 7/28 for a 7-day run. Constraints: two priority infra projects (observability rollout and internal training cluster) consume most spare capacity this month.

Options:
- Option A (fastest validation): shift the controlled run to 7/28–8/03; we may still hit the 30% target by the end of Q3 if results are strong.
- Option B (partial deploy): provide +2 T4s on 7/24 for a limited run focused on batching only (smaller statistical significance).

I attached an infra_capacity_plan.pdf with the allocation windows. If leadership accepts Option A, I need a formal sign-off by 7/25 to reserve the pool.

Attachment: infra_capacity_plan.pdf

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: sara.connors@acme.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Goal triage and dependency escalation for Q3 midpoint — Proposed routing changes & QBR agenda

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed routing changes & QBR agenda
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Sara — looping you in on our internal conversation and a proposed approach for the QBR. Brief items below:

1) Routing/latency approach (Product recommendation)
- For the next 6 weeks we propose excluding experimental low-traffic regions from the default cross-region routing. Critical production routes (auth, invoices, real-time features) remain multi-region. This reduces noise in the 99p metric while maintaining coverage for customer-facing routes.
- Expected effect: NA 99p should drop ~30ms in the first 2 weeks; we will monitor and report weekly.

2) QBR agenda (45 + 30)
- 0–5 min: Exec intro (Jonas)
- 5–20 min: Current performance & metrics (Laura)
- 20–40 min: Product roadmap & near-term mitigations (Grace)
- 40–50 min: Infra validation plan (Marcus)
- 50–75 min: Open discussion + next steps (mutual action plan)

3) Ask for ACME: please share any priority routes you want flagged as critical before the QBR so we can exclude them from routing changes.

We will publish a mutual_action_plan.md after the QBR and share action owners.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Product | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, sara.connors@acme.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goal triage and dependency escalation for Q3 midpoint — final decisions & action items

Thanks everyone — consolidating decisions from this thread.

Decisions:
- Infra run: accept Marcus Option A (7/28–8/03 full test). Marcus to reserve pool; sign-off required 7/25 (we missed that, but Marcus has confirmed availability on 7/28). Attachment infra_capacity_plan.pdf accepted.
- Objective B: temporary routing scope reduction approved for 6 weeks; Grace to publish exact route exclude list by 7/30.
- ACME QBR: scheduled for 7/29 09:00 PT (Laura to send meeting invite). Attendees: Laura, Grace, Marcus, Jonas (exec intro). Sara — thanks for joining; please send any critical routes prior to tomorrow 7/29 08:00 PT.

Action items (owners / due):
- Marcus: reserve infra pool for 7/28–8/03 and run validation (due 7/28).
- Grace: publish route exclude list & deck for QBR (due 7/30).
- Laura: send ACME meeting invite + draft mutual action plan (due 7/23 for draft, finalized after QBR).
- Jonas: publish updated KR statements and timeline after QBR (due 7/30).

Links: Drive scoreboard (QBR_metrics_v2.xlsx): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cQBR
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7892

I'll update the executive tracker after the QBR.

Thanks,
Jonas
